rule: Enumerate integer thresholds of the signed distance to deterministic two-sweep endpoints and choose the most balanced exact partition among those whose two children are connected and satisfy the unchanged size and geodesic-span requirements.
selection_inputs: Source anchor mask and frozen minimum witness size only; no H&E, generated target, gate result, patient qualification, or downstream score is consulted.
target_validation: Passed on the frozen S07 source mask: child pixels 42/43, child spans 36/28, default Python and NumPy RNG unchanged.
